title: Across the Hall
warm:

Mid-forties finance and tech holding, brutal charm under pressure. Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rose without a body. Vivienne's four fates stayed open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Marcus Pell preferred silence. Rhea Quinn's slate had already paid ash.

"They are reviewing me for you," Nolan said, cufflinks clicking once. "Soft alibi became a conflict of interest with a pulse. Soft still keeps you from becoming Brooks's sharpest edge. Soft also means you choose whether quiet deal or Pell-bargain owns the next hour."

Wine rings on marble. Elevator chime in the shared shaft. Unused perfume from the master bath she should not know. Black car at the curb. Wind sheer. Hope and dread shared the hallway geography that had always been the affair's geometry.

[player_name] catalogued inquiry heat: closeness named, calendar cadence weekly to monthly to gone still contested, no settled corpse. Across-the-hall visits had always been risk; now risk had a badge number and a board.

"Quiet-deal the pressure," Nolan offered, almost kind. "Or bargain with Pell—seal soft into fixer teeth. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend Layer 8."

Choice verbs waited. Crownspire held its hush. City light as accusation. Soft alibi had become the reason for review and the reason she still crossed twelve steps.
